snippet.title: Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery! - Character introduction PV
snippet.description:
"Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery!" is a werewolf game-style social deduction adventure in which the main character, a landlord, searches for a monster that has sneaked into his apartment. 
Scheduled to start selling on Steam in 2025!
This time we will mainly introduce the characters that appear in the first half of the game! #YokaiLandlord

■Official website
https://oyaoya-ooya3.com/
